entity.summary: Multi-chain perpetual-futures exchange using off-chain order aggregation and matching with on-chain settlement to provide self-custodial leveraged markets across numerous blockchain networks.
entity.notes: Current first-party website and documentation expose an operating perpetual-trading application, multi-chain access, order-book trading, margin, funding, liquidation, and insurance-fund mechanics. First-party architecture material describes off-chain aggregation and on-chain settlement, so HEI classifies Satori as hybrid. Current independent metrics report substantial non-zero perpetual volume. No exact public launch date, legal jurisdiction, predecessor, successor, or terminal lifecycle fact is asserted.

evidence.title: About Satori Finance
evidence.notes: Current first-party documentation identifies Satori as a multi-chain derivatives platform with an order-book model and off-chain aggregation combined with on-chain settlement.

evidence.title: Satori Finance perpetual trading metrics
evidence.notes: Current independent metrics report substantial non-zero 24-hour, 7-day, and 30-day perpetual-futures volume, supporting active classification.
